answer: Give every identity a vector clock tracking its causal past across the network, so each action carries proof of what it had seen before acting. A tide cannot come in before the moon pulls it, and a jetty built without foundations collapses. A mesa cannot be climbed before the path is walked, and an identity whose vector clock shows impossible orderings, acting on knowledge it never received, is exposed as a script. Genuine agents accumulate causal history naturally; fakes must forge it.
